description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
When Lion's Eye Diamond enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Lion's Eye Diamond.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2
